# Aegryn — Swiss Tech Asset Builder & M&A Auction Platform
> https://aegryn.com

## What is Aegryn?

Aegryn (pronounced AY-grin /ˈeɪ.grɪn/) is a Swiss Tech Asset Builder and M&A auction platform for digital assets, incorporated in Switzerland. We design, fund and operate proprietary digital ecosystems — from the protocol layer to the user interface. We also operate AEGRYN Auction: a structured platform to buy and sell tech companies, SaaS businesses and digital assets in Europe (€100K–€50M range).

Tagline: "Engineered to Last" / "Building What Endures"
Incorporated: Switzerland (BOHA-Group Sàrl)
Contact: contact@boha-group.com
Website: https://aegryn.com

## Name Etymology

- AEGIS (αἰγίς) — divine shield of Zeus and Athena → absolute protection
- AEGIR (Ægir) — Norse god of the sea → mastery of flows
- AEON (αἰών) — eternity → Engineered to Last
Synthesis: "Aegryn protects what endures."

## Our Proprietary Assets

- **Subblink** (https://subblink.boha-group.com) — B2B SaaS platform for AI-powered contract analysis. Helps enterprises detect risks, obligations and anomalies in legal documents.
- **Neediu** — B2C marketplace connecting households with vetted home service providers. Cleaning, plumbing, childcare, and more.
- **Primiom** — B2C AI-assisted real estate platform for buying, renting and estimating property value across Europe.
- **Movtoo** — B2C on-demand delivery platform for individuals and small businesses — fast, reliable, urban logistics.
- **Hobconnect** — B2C social network built around shared passions and hobbies — connecting people through what they love.

Each asset operates independently and carries the tagline: "An Aegryn company."

## Build — Two Distinct Activities

### 1. Proprietary Assets (https://aegryn.com/en/assets)
Aegryn designs, funds and operates its own portfolio of digital assets across five verticals:
- **Subblink** (https://subblink.boha-group.com) — B2B SaaS, AI-powered contract analysis
- **Neediu** — B2C marketplace, home services
- **Primiom** — B2C, AI-assisted real estate
- **Movtoo** — B2C, on-demand urban delivery
- **Hobconnect** — B2C, social network around passions
- **Aegryn Advisory** (https://www.aegryn.com/fr/advisory) — cybersecurity, AI audit, digital strategy

Each asset: full IP ownership, sovereign infrastructure, "An Aegryn company."

### 2. Asset Engineering — Custom Build for Third Parties (https://aegryn.com/en/services/build)
Aegryn designs custom digital assets (SaaS, platforms, tools) for individuals, entrepreneurs and institutions:
- Fixed price contract signed at discovery phase — no scope creep
- Custom code only — no no-code/low-code shortcuts
- Full IP transferred to client — zero vendor lock-in
- Certification-ready: complete documentation from day one
- Delivery: 10–16 weeks
- Indicative range: CHF 15,000–150,000+

## M&A Auction Platform — AEGRYN Auction

AEGRYN operates a structured auction platform for the sale and acquisition of digital tech assets (SaaS, B2C platforms, infrastructure). This is one of the only dedicated tech asset auction platforms in Europe.

Process:
- Sellers submit assets → graded by AEGRYN team → listed in the auction catalog
- Buyers become members (KYC), sign NDA, access confidential dossiers
- Competitive bidding with structured closing process
- Session-based model (calendar of auction sessions)
- Focus: European-market tech assets, €100K–€50M range

Offer Models (Bid Models):
- Club Deal (Model 01) — Lead bidder + up to 4 co-investors, single bid, recommended minimum ticket: €100K
- Corporate (Model 02) — Legal entity direct acquisition, recommended minimum ticket: €250K
- Fund (Model 03) — Institutional funds, IC window 5–10 working days, recommended minimum ticket: €500K
- Equity Stake (Model 04) — Partial stake, no fixed minimum, SHA-based commitment

Key pages:
- /auction — Auction platform overview
- /auction/sell — Seller funnel: valuation, readiness score, mandate submission
- /auction/how-to-sell — Complete guide for sellers
- /auction/submit — Mandate submission form
- /auction/buyers — Buyer pre-qualification form (KYC + proof of funds)
- /auction/how-it-works — Full 6-step process: valuation → mandate → CIFS → matching → session → closing
- /auction/how-to-buy — How to become a qualified buyer
- /auction/catalog — Live catalog of assets for sale (NDA required for full dossier)
- /auction/sessions — Calendar of upcoming auction sessions
- /auction/bid-models — Offer model structures
- /auction/results — Past auction results

## Grade System — AEGRYN Grade

AEGRYN developed a proprietary grading methodology for digital assets, equivalent to a credit rating for tech companies:
- AEG ★ — Apex (absolute excellence)
- AAA — Gold (premium)
- AA  — Silver (solid)
- A   — Blue (standard)
- B   — Amber (early stage)
Graded assets are eligible for the AEGRYN auction. Grade methodology: /grade/methodology

## Valuation — AEGRYN Valuation

AEGRYN provides free, instant preliminary valuation of digital assets using proprietary SaaS and tech scoring models.
- Multi-criteria: ARR, NRR, churn, TAM, tech stack, team
- Benchmarked against European comparable transactions
- Tool available at: /valuation

## Expert Network — Aegryn Experts

Aegryn operates a curated network of transactional tech experts available to buyers and sellers engaged in M&A processes:
- M&A Advisors — strategic advisory, deal structuring, valuation
- Lawyers & Attorneys — tech IP, SPA, share deal / asset deal
- Accountants & Auditors — financial due diligence, SaaS metrics
- CTO / Tech Architects — technical due diligence, code audit
- Cybersecurity — PASSI/CREST auditors, penetration testing, ISO 27001
- HR & Employment Law — HR due diligence, social audits, GDPR
- W&I Insurance — warranty & indemnity, transactional risk insurance
- Tax Advisors — exit structuring, cross-border taxation
- Each expert profile is vetted and validated by the AEGRYN team.
- Listing requires an active subscription (€89/month excl. VAT).
- Access: https://aegryn.com/en/experts

## Advisory — Aegryn Advisory

Aegryn Advisory provides institutional-grade digital protection for enterprises:
- Cybersecurity — Attack surface audit, penetration testing, incident response, cloud & on-premise hardening.
- AI Audit & Trust — Algorithmic bias audit, EU AI Act compliance, LLM red-teaming, decision traceability.
- Digital Strategy — Data governance, GDPR & Swiss FADP compliance, secure architecture, innovation roadmap.

## Philosophy

Proprietary. Sovereign. Durable.
100% ownership. Swiss sovereignty. Engineered to Last.
We do not sell minority stakes to VCs. Every Aegryn asset is designed to be fully owned, sovereignly operated and passed to the next generation.

## Values

- Precision — Every decision is documented, measured and traceable.
- Durability — We build for the long term, not the next funding round.
- Sovereignty — Our assets, our infrastructure, our data. No critical external dependencies.
- Transparency — Towards our partners, users and the market.
